text:
```yaml
name: Promote Dev Profile Images

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  unit-tests:
    name: Run Cloud Dashboard Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          npm test -- --ci --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Publish JUnit test results to GitHub
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          junit_files: junit.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Show test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: junit.xml
          output: test-summary.md
          show: true
          folded: false

      - name: Publish test results to Testspace
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}
          config-args: --project=backbay-labs/clawdstrike --build=${{ github.sha }}
```
